title: Global Room Color Scheme (Administrator+)
body:
Syntax: colorscheme
        colorscheme name <0-255>
        colorscheme desc <0-255>
        colorscheme exits <0-255>
        colorscheme set <name> <desc> <exits>
        colorscheme show | colorscheme preview | colorscheme reset
Aliases: roomscheme; name/title/roomname, desc/description/roomdesc, exits/exit. You may use numeric colors or &[208] xterm tags.

Administrator or Implementor access only. Changes affect EVERY player's future room look/scan display immediately. The command shows a preview of your current room after updating. Each accepted change is atomically and automatically saved in data/color_scheme.json, without needing save world. Colors are restored at server boot and survive reboots/crashes. Builder rooms and saved world/area files are NEVER rewritten by this command. Reset returns to Ember name 208, Sand description 223, and classic green exits.
